key_highlights: ASX closed the week lower as traders priced in further RBA rate hikes, with Greg Jericho urging caution before another increase given a stalling economy
Aussie banks forecast record house price falls; CBA reports home loan applications down 15% since the federal budget, signalling deep credit contraction
Housing affordability hits all-time low even as prices decline, with construction expected to follow prices lower
Iron ore sector faces a structural shakeout masked by geopolitical war premiums; Macarthur clears WA bulk test hurdle
Bathla's collapse flagged as a systemic warning for Australia's construction sector and broader 'Ponzi economy' dynamics
Gold strength persists: Bitcoin-gold correlation at six-year high, Dutch CB repatriates bars from NY amid geopolitical risk
Small-cap mining active: Kaoko Metals, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Aurum, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals in focus
EV sales overtake petrol cars for first time in Australia, driven by soaring fuel costs
ASIC launches whistleblower review at Big Four accounting firms; Victoria's soaring debt draws ratings agency warnings
Australia's per-capita economy stalls while Canada's soars; political optimism at multi-year low

sectors.trend: Iron ore faces a structural shakeout hidden behind war-driven price support; small-cap explorers (Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche, Aurum, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) see elevated activity. Macarthur clears WA bulk test. Gold remains a safe-haven magnet.
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face margin pressure once war premiums fade. Small-cap gold and critical-mines names offer relative outperformance. Monitor iron ore contract vs spot divergence.

sectors.trend: CBA reports 15% drop in home loan applications post-budget; banks forecast record house price declines. CBA and Westpac face scrutiny over loyalty-customer pricing loopholes. ASIC whistleblower review at Big Four adds regulatory overhang.
sectors.implications: NIM compression and credit-loss provisions likely to pressure CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX earnings. Regulatory risk elevated. Defensive dividend yield remains attractive but growth outlook weak.

sectors.trend: TMK Energy gas rates surge ahead of Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo flagged to challenge gas cartel; energy transition costs mounting and 'running off the rails'. EV adoption accelerates on fuel-cost arbitrage.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, BOQ.AX, SXG.AX benefit from gas price strength. Transition-cost overhang weighs on utilities. EV supply-chain names gain secular tailwind.

sectors.trend: Fred Hollows' future under threat; Ozempic maker (Novo Nordisk) in trouble, shifting demand toward tablet GLP-1 alternatives. Consumer sentiment weak amid political pessimism.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX remains a quality anchor but sector sentiment soft. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOL.AX) offer defensive rotation. Monitor CSL pipeline updates.

sectors.trend: Bathla collapse signals systemic construction stress; housing construction to follow falling prices. Melbourne councils admit infrastructure cannot cope with planned population growth. Victoria debt draws ratings warnings.
sectors.implications: CGC.AX, WBC.AX (construction exposure), and property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX) face headwinds. Infrastructure names (WES.AX, IAG.AX) may benefit from public-works substitution.

sectors.trend: Nvidia signals AI boom continues; Micron shaping AI landscape; skilled-migrant priority shifts to AI workers and tradies. Data-centre community backlash persists.
sectors.implications: Limited direct ASX exposure but supports AUD via global risk appetite. Local tech (W1.AX, XRO.AX) benefit from AI infrastructure spend. Watch AUD/USD for cross-asset flows.

key_themes: RBA rate-hike risk vs stalling growth – policy dilemma
Housing credit contraction and record affordability crisis
Iron ore structural shakeout beneath war premium
Gold as geopolitical safe haven; central-bank repatriation
Energy transition cost overhang and gas price strength
EV adoption inflection point in Australia
Regulatory scrutiny: ASIC whistleblower review, bank pricing loopholes

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike in a stalling economy
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds; underweight rate-sensitive REITs and construction; monitor RBA statement and CPI print.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing credit contraction and price spiral
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to property-linked REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX) and construction (CGC.AX); favour cash-generative defensives.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand shock post-war premium
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify mining exposure toward gold (SGR.AX, NVG.AX) and critical minerals; monitor BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX guidance.
Hedge AUD exposure; maintain gold allocation; monitor Dutch CB gold repatriation as signal of broader de-dollarisation.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Regulatory / governance shock (ASIC, Big Four, banks)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid names under active ASIC review; monitor CBA.AX, WBC.AX for pricing-loophole remediation costs.
Prefer gas-exposed names (WDS.AX, BOQ.AX) over renewables capex-heavy peers; watch AEMO cost disclosures.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and critical-mines small caps
opportunities.rationale: Six-year-high BTC-gold correlation, Dutch CB repatriation, and active small-cap mining (Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche, Aurum) signal safe-haven and critical-mines demand.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long on gas-exposed energy names
opportunities.rationale: TMK gas rate surge and Beetaloo cartel challenge support upstream gas pricing; energy transition costs favour conventional gas as bridge fuel.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective quality defensives in healthcare and staples
opportunities.rationale: Political pessimism and credit contraction favour cash-generative, low-beta names; CSL remains a structural anchor.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce property REIT and construction exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Record house-price fall forecasts, 15% loan-application drop, Bathla collapse, and construction slowdown create multi-quarter headwinds.
RBA hike risk plus credit-loss provisions and regulatory scrutiny (ASIC, pricing loopholes) pressure CBA, WBC, NAB, ANZ margins.
Structural shakeout beneath war premium; Macarthur bulk test signals new supply; China demand uncertainty.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months as RBA rate-hike expectations, housing credit contraction, and construction stress dominate. Gold and gas names outperform. Expect volatility around RBA decisions and CPI prints. ^AXJO likely to test lower support.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pivots to pause/cut and housing stabilises. 'Bull case returns' narrative gains traction if iron ore shakeout is absorbed and AI capex cycle sustains. Structural risks (construction fragility, energy transition costs, political pessimism) cap upside. Canada-Australia per-capita divergence may prompt policy response.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement (next meeting)
Iron ore contract price post-war-premium normalisation
CBA/WBC home-loan pipeline and NIM guidance
Victoria state debt ratings review outcome
watch_list: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX iron ore guidance
SGR.AX, NVG.AX gold production and pricing
CSL.AX pipeline and GLP-1 tablet competition
Nvidia, Micron earnings (global AI sentiment proxy)
